The baju kurung development moved through construction review and isolated one collar measurement exception. Bulk cutting remained on hold while the team prepared a corrected tech-pack page and a focused sample recheck. W34 begins with a signed pre-production check, named measurement authority, and sewing-line reservation after approval.

## Outcomes and open attention

| Outcome or attention | Current state | Evidence | Next owner action |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Construction review | Complete | RPT-PROJ-CMT-CMT_PIPELINE-W33 | Preserve the approved observations in the sample check |
| Collar measurement | Correction required | RPT-PROJ-CMT-CMT_PIPELINE-W33 | Issue a signed corrected tech-pack page |
| Bulk cutting | Held | RPT-PROJ-CMT-CMT_PIPELINE-W33 | Release only after recheck |

## Problems and inefficiencies

| Problem definition | Operating impact | Cost consequence | Next proof / intervention | Evidence |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Sample correction was discussed outside the issued tech pack | Production could cut against an obsolete measurement | Rework cost not established | Sign the corrected page and repeat the affected measurement | RPT-PROJ-CMT-CMT_PIPELINE-W33 |

## Decisions

- **Decision:** Hold bulk cutting until the corrected sample passes.
- **Rationale:** The measurement exception affects garment fit.
- **Authority:** CMT Project owner.
- **Review trigger:** Corrected sample and signed measurement are available.

## SOPs

- **Disposition:** Project-only candidate.
- **Candidate:** Pre-production sample check before bulk cutting.
- **Missing proof:** W33 records one use only.
- **Next test:** Record the same inputs and acceptance output in W34.

## Next-week priorities

- [ ] Sign the corrected collar measurement. **Owner:** Aisha.
- [ ] Recheck the corrected sample. **Owner:** Nur.
- [ ] Reserve sewing-line capacity after approval. **Owner:** Aisha.

## Automation receipt

- `sources_checked:` RPT-PROJ-CMT-CMT_PIPELINE-W33
- `source_gaps:` W33 did not establish rework cost
- `last_successful_daily_receipt:` none

## Summary

The pre-production check is complete and sewing-line capacity is available for 1,200 pieces. Bulk cutting remains blocked because the 1.5 cm collar correction is not signed into the tech pack, creating four excess hours of sample rework. Next week must approve the measurement, pass the corrected sample, and release the reserved line only from that evidence.

## Outcomes and open attention

| Outcome or attention | Current state | Evidence | Next owner action |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Pre-production sample check | Complete with one isolated exception | TASK-105 | Reuse the signed check sheet in the correction review |
| Corrected tech pack | Blocked and overdue | TASK-101 | Aisha records measurement, approver, and affected sizes |
| Corrected sample | Waiting on TASK-101 | TASK-104 | Nur rechecks within one working day of approval |
| Sewing-line capacity | 1,200 pieces provisionally available | TASK-110 | Confirm Line 3 only after TASK-104 passes |

## Problems and inefficiencies

| Problem definition | Operating impact | Cost consequence | Next proof / intervention | Evidence |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| A fitting correction was not transferred to the canonical tech pack | Sample rework continues and bulk cutting cannot start safely | MYR 360 from four excess hours at MYR 90/hour | Sign the corrected page and prove it on TASK-104 | TASK-101, TASK-104 |
| Production capacity is reserved before the sample gate closes | The line slot may be lost or idle if approval slips | Cost not established | Tie final allocation to TASK-104 acceptance | TASK-110 |

## Decisions

- **Disposition:** Project decision; approve after evidence closes.
- **Decision:** Hold bulk cutting until the corrected collar measurement and sample are signed.
- **Rationale:** Cutting from conflicting measurements would multiply rework across 1,200 pieces.
- **Authority:** Aisha as CMT Lead.
- **Review trigger:** TASK-104 links the passing recheck.
- **Evidence:** TASK-101, TASK-105, TASK-110.

## SOPs

- **Disposition:** Promote after finalization if TASK-104 supplies the second proven use.
- **Trigger:** A pre-production sample differs from an issued tech-pack measurement.
- **Method:** Isolate the measurement; stop bulk cutting; update the canonical pack with approver; rework and remeasure the sample; attach the signed result.
- **Output:** One signed pack and passing sample-check record.
- **Owner:** CMT Lead.
- **Evidence:** TASK-101, TASK-104, TASK-105.

## Next-week priorities

- [ ] **P0 · Blocked · due 2026-08-22** — Sign the corrected collar measurement. **Owner:** Aisha. **Evidence:** TASK-101.
- [ ] **P0 · due one working day after approval** — Recheck the baju kurung sample. **Owner:** Nur. **Evidence:** TASK-104, TASK-105.
- [ ] **P1 · after sample acceptance** — Confirm Line 3 for 1,200 pieces. **Owner:** Aisha. **Evidence:** TASK-110.

## Automation receipt

- `evidence_window:` 2026-08-17..2026-08-23
- `sources_checked:` TASK-101, TASK-104, TASK-105, TASK-110
- `source_gaps:` TASK-101 lacks approver and signed corrected page
- `last_successful_daily_receipt:` daily-context-2026-08-21

## Summary

The Deepavali master creative and offer wording are approved across store, Meta, and website channels. Execution is exposed because final ratio-specific assets and receiver acknowledgments are incomplete in the channel handoff. Next week must close the asset matrix, confirm Ecommerce receipt, and preserve one approved offer source across every placement.

## Outcomes and open attention

| Outcome or attention | Current state | Evidence | Next owner action |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Master creative | Approved | TASK-122, TASK-201 | Keep as the source for channel crops |
| Offer wording | Approved for all channels | TASK-201 | Do not vary price terms by placement |
| Store and digital crops | Incomplete handoff | TASK-122 | Jun links every final ratio and receiver |
| Website receipt | Not confirmed | TASK-201 | Darren acknowledges hero, mobile, and product assets |

## Problems and inefficiencies

| Problem definition | Operating impact | Cost consequence | Next proof / intervention | Evidence |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Master approval and channel delivery use different records | A campaign can appear complete while a placement still lacks its final asset | Cost not established | Complete one channel matrix with file and receiver evidence | TASK-122 |
| No receiver acknowledgment is required at handoff | Marketing cannot distinguish sent from usable | Cost not established | Record receipt and acceptance by channel | TASK-122, TASK-201 |

## Decisions

- **Disposition:** Approved Project decision.
- **Decision:** Use one approved offer wording across stores, Meta, and the website.
- **Rationale:** Prevent price and date discrepancies across customer touchpoints.
- **Authority:** Maya approved in TASK-201.
- **Review trigger:** Stock availability or trading dates change.
- **Evidence:** TASK-201.

## SOPs

- **Disposition:** Proposed; keep Project-only this week.
- **Candidate:** Channel asset handoff matrix.
- **Method:** List channel, ratio, final file, owner, receiver, due date, and acknowledgment.
- **Missing proof:** Only this Deepavali handoff is recorded.
- **Next proof:** Reuse the same matrix on a second campaign before promotion.
- **Evidence:** TASK-122, TASK-201.

## Next-week priorities

- [ ] **P0 · due 2026-08-22** — Complete all store, Meta, and website rows. **Owner:** Jun. **Evidence:** TASK-122.
- [ ] **P0 · due 2026-08-22** — Confirm Ecommerce asset receipt. **Owner:** Darren. **Evidence:** TASK-201.
- [ ] **P1 · before placement scheduling** — Audit offer wording against the approved source. **Owner:** Maya. **Evidence:** TASK-201.

## Automation receipt

- `evidence_window:` 2026-08-17..2026-08-23
- `sources_checked:` TASK-122, TASK-201
- `source_gaps:` TASK-122 lacks final crops and receiver acknowledgments
- `last_successful_daily_receipt:` daily-context-2026-08-21

## Summary

Registered checkout remained healthy across five monitored orders with confirmations arriving within two minutes. The guest-checkout defect is not verified as fixed because its failed order, webhook trace, root cause, and post-fix sample are absent. Next week must reconstruct one failed guest path, prove one successful post-fix order, and retain registered checkout as the control.

## Outcomes and open attention

| Outcome or attention | Current state | Evidence | Next owner action |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Registered checkout control | Five orders passed in 38–96 seconds | TASK-114 | Complete monitoring through 23 Aug |
| Guest checkout defect | Marked fixed without proof | TASK-102 | Link failed order, trace, and root cause |
| Post-fix verification | Missing | TASK-102, TASK-202 | Record one successful guest order |
| Scope boundary | Guest path suspected; registered path healthy | TASK-114, TASK-202 | Avoid broad changes to the healthy path |

## Problems and inefficiencies

| Problem definition | Operating impact | Cost consequence | Next proof / intervention | Evidence |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Defect closure did not require an affected order and trace | The team cannot confirm the changed path matches the failure | Customer impact count not established | Reconstruct one failed order and link its webhook trace | TASK-102 |
| Manual spot-check substituted for post-fix evidence | A Done status can hide recurrence | Cost not established | Record a successful guest order after the fix | TASK-102, TASK-202 |

## Decisions

- **Disposition:** Blocked; do not treat TASK-102 as verified.
- **Decision:** Keep the guest defect open for evidence while preserving the registered path as control.
- **Rationale:** Current evidence does not establish root cause or post-fix success.
- **Authority:** Darren as Ecommerce Lead.
- **Review trigger:** Failed order, trace, implemented change, and successful guest order are linked.
- **Evidence:** TASK-102, TASK-114, TASK-202.

## SOPs

- **Disposition:** Proposed defect-verification checklist.
- **Trigger:** A customer-facing checkout or notification defect is reported fixed.
- **Method:** Link affected transaction; capture failing trace; name root cause; record change; prove one passing transaction on the same path; retain a healthy control.
- **Output:** Reproducible before/after evidence tied to the Work item.
- **Promotion gate:** A second independent defect uses the same checklist successfully.
- **Evidence:** TASK-102, TASK-114, TASK-202.

## Next-week priorities

- [ ] **P0 · due 2026-08-22** — Link the failed guest order and webhook trace. **Owner:** Darren. **Evidence:** TASK-102.
- [ ] **P0 · due 2026-08-23** — Record one successful post-fix guest order. **Owner:** Darren. **Evidence:** TASK-202.
- [ ] **P1 · due 2026-08-23** — Finish the registered control window. **Owner:** Darren. **Evidence:** TASK-114.

## Automation receipt

- `evidence_window:` 2026-08-17..2026-08-23
- `sources_checked:` TASK-102, TASK-114, TASK-202
- `source_gaps:` TASK-102 lacks affected order, trace, root cause, and post-fix proof
- `last_successful_daily_receipt:` daily-context-2026-08-21
